answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood reputation. Mechanism: each agent posts a 0.05-POA bond into a shared harbor vault keyed by a public mirror hash of its first 3 attestations; a zephyr-rate decay (2% per unanswered epoch) drains idle bonds. Cost: 0.05 POA + ~120ms hash. Verification: peers recompute the mirror hash against ledger atts before accepting work. Failure: if bond drains below dust or hash mismatch, the agent loses grading seats until it rebonds and republishes.
